The Collaboration DNA

The King of Pop Meets
the King of Trunks.

Heritage isn't just about looking back it's about moving forward with rhythm. The Bouton d'Or collection is the physical manifestation of a high-stakes collision between Louis Vuitton's ancestral savoir-faire in trunk-making and the iconic theatricality of Michael Jackson's Dangerous era.

Inspired by military-braided jackets and LV's 1year legacy of crafting the world's finest trunks, every stitch tells a story of precision. Every gold bead pays homage to a life lived entirely in the spotlight.

"This isn't just a sneaker. It's a piece of performance history."

Savoir-Faire

The Object

Built Without Compromise

Upper Material
Obsidian black and deep red tumbled calfskin leather Taurillon grain, hand-selected.
Gold Hardware
18k gold-braided military frogging with LV-stamped beads. Industrial side-zipper, gold-toned, LV-engraved pull.
Architectural Heel
Polished heel strap deep-embossed: LOUIS VUITTON in 18k gold lettering. Brass-locked ankle strap.
Interior Luxury
Stark white quilted leather lining. MJ cursive signature embroidered in gold thread on the insole.
Collector's Outsole
Black rubber, full LV monogram tread in gold. 'MJ 2026.' signature plate cast in brass, set in the arch.
Edition & Packaging
500 numbered pairs worldwide. Delivered in a bespoke monogrammed LV trunk box with brass locks and Certificate of Authenticity.
The Delivery

Arriving in History

Each pair arrives sealed inside a bespoke monogrammed LV trunk. Inside: the sneakers wrapped in gold tissue, a numbered Certificate of Authenticity on brass plate, and a collector's booklet documenting the full collaboration story.

Authenticity Guaranteed
Each pair carries an embedded NFC chip linked to a blockchain Certificate of Authenticity. Serial No. LV-MJ 001/500.

The Visionary Behind the Collection

Brand Director Men's Special Projects

Youssef Najim

Concept, Creation
& Direction.

The Bouton d'Or collection was conceived, directed, and brought to life by Youssef Najim, Brand Director of Men's Special Projects. A collector, a creative, and a lifelong admirer of both houses, Youssef spent two years building the bridge between LV's ancestral trunk-making heritage and the theatrical universe of the King of Pop.

Every detail from the hand-braided military frogging to the 'MJ 2026.' brass plate in the arch carries his signature. This collection is, above all, a love letter to Michael Jackson and to the house of Louis Vuitton.

"Made with love for MJ
and for Louis Vuitton."

Youssef Najim
